answer: Proof of Burn acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent networks. By requiring agents to provably destroy native tokens, the system ensures that identity creation costs are non-trivial. Like a willow bending under market pressure, the network can harbor only those agents willing to undergo capital depletion. An attacker seeking to flood the orchard of synthetic entities faces prohibitive financial attrition, as each fraudulent identity requires a burned stake that renders large-scale deception economically irrational.
